packet.title: Evaluator performance (implementation)
packet.summary: Speeds up the evaluator with general mechanisms: a benchmark set in tests/bench/, axis walks that describe each node once, filter indexes from an IR pass, and a hoist pass.

body.p: After (the evaluator runs about 4 million steps a second and has no index for joins), (QT4 app-Demos itunes is quadratic by its own text, 72 s) and (match="$var" membership is a linear scan).

item.p: Mechanism: general mechanisms of the one IR and evaluator, no language-specific machinery: a benchmark set (tests/bench/), axis steps that describe each node once, and filter indexes: an IR pass (the optimizer seam, ) gives a FILTER whose predicate needs "key = probe", "eq" or "is" a filter index, a for clause's where becomes such a FILTER, and the evaluator keeps the index in the evaluation memo ().
Owns: tests/bench/, src/tree_axis.c, src/evaluator_path.c, src/evaluator_index.c, src/ir_loop_passes.c; the FILTER parts of src/evaluator.c, src/ir.c, src/ir_verify.c, src/ir_internal.h.

Done when: the baseline and the numbers after each change in a D-record and the commit messages; no QT4 XQ40 or XT40 outcome changes; , the memory limits and honest step counts kept. Done 2026-10-19 (): tests/bench/; axis walks; filter indexes (the filter-index pass, src/evaluator_index.c); a path's step from all origins at once; the hoist pass. xmark-all 6.73 to 1.52 processor seconds, app-Demos itunes 80.6 to 3.4; QT4 XQ40 and XT40 unchanged case by case.
